name: Sarzana Seaside Cubing 2022
information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbWNWIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--729b06128e55d51f6950d032c9d32ee15eef1de2/logo_comune_sarzana%20copy.jpeg)

Questa competizione si svolge con il supporto del Comune di Sarzana.


## **FFP2 MASKS ARE MANDATORY**
Please check the [COVID-19 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SarzanaSeasideCubing2022#17957-covid-19) to understand the safety rules enforced at this competition.
**Note: you will have to pay extra at the venue €10 if you are not a Cubing Italy member.
It's free, discover how to in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SarzanaSeasideCubing2022#17956-registration-registrazione).**

Possiamo accogliere 100 accompagnatori. Ogni partecipante ha diritto ad un solo accompagnatore. Eventuali accompagnatori in piú saranno accettati solamente se il limite di 100 accompagnatori non è stato raggiunto.

---

## **MASCHERINE FFP2 OBBLIGATORIE**
Consulta la [sezione COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SarzanaSeasideCubing2022#17957-covid-19) per comprendere le norme di sicurezza della competizione.
**Nota: dovrai pagare altri €10 in loco se non ti associ a Cubing Italy.
È gratis, scopri come nella [sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SarzanaSeasideCubing2022#17956-registration-registrazione).**

We can accept up to 100 guests. Each competitor is entitled to only one guest. Additional guests will only be accepted if the limit of 100 has not been reached.
